summary: Read effective provider YAML and template configuration rather than broad release-era comments: current fable-game source selects provider contract 2.0.0, SDD minimum 2.1.0, Workspace.Template 0.19.0 and omission default typed-sdd; fable-bindings retains omission default sdd. The older README statement that every provider omission resolves to sdd is not the actual fable-game descriptor. PortalExample is explicit opt-in, default false, a separate managed .NET project inside a genuine Fable Game workspace; it is not browser physics or production server integration. The owning Portal ledger records scoped public 0.18.2 direct, retained and provider receivers and removal/recovery, but whole P3 remains open for performance release, Portal-to-Portal upgrade and global wizard outcomes. Default source selection, package publication, registry activation and every retained upgrade are distinct joins.
title: Effective provider selection and opt-in managed Portal
